rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for unauthorized copying or pirated goods.

example.english: This disc is an example of piracy; it is cheap, but the quality is much worse.
example.traditional: 呢隻碟係盜版，平就平，但係質素差好多。
example.jyutping: ne1 zek3 dip6 hai6 dou6 baan2 ping4 zau6 ping4 daan6 hai6 zat1 sou3 caa1 hou2 do1

rows.note: Use this specifically for robbery or seizure of ships at sea, rather than copyright infringement.

example.english: The shipping company strengthened its escort to guard against piracy.
example.traditional: 船公司加強護航，防範海盜行為。
